title: feat(runtime)!: refuse runtime package operations when multi-replica is declared (#3814 F3c, D1)
body:
epic:#3814#1 · os-zhuang · session_01QUs3BrVu5TqwtmuhsjdEvM
Filing gate: ③ maintainer-dispatched task (child of #3814). Maintainer, (2026-11-08, 16:25 UTC): 「继续，现在派第二批」 (gate 1 after the card 0 inventory, cloud#3868 comment 6723322368).

Parent: #3814 (rulings R0-R6 on comment 6722625146).

## Problem (smoke, card 0)
- Package registry: loaded from the DB at boot only. A customization package created on r1 (`ensure-customization`) was in `sys_packages`, but r2 answered 404 for over 20 s and until restart.
- Package enable/disable: written to `OS_HOME/package-state/<hash>.json` because the EE assembly has no host package-state store (`runtime/domains/packages.ts:795`). After a disable on r1 and a restart of r2, r2 served the package enabled while r1 had it disabled: a permanent divergence on separate volumes.

## Do
1. Maintainer ruling D1 (2026-11-08, 16:25 UTC): 「多副本时拒绝」. When multi-replica is declared on the Redis driver, the runtime package doors that change the registry or package state (create/ensure customization package, enable, disable, runtime install/uninstall, and any sibling door the PR finds) refuse loudly with one stable error code and a message naming the maintenance-window recipe: run the change on a single replica or through the CLI, then restart every replica.
2. Reuse the predicate from the install-local refusal card (R6) so both refusals agree; whichever lands second imports the first.
3. Single node unchanged.
4. Tests: each door refused under declared multi-replica + Redis with the code; each door works as today on a single node; a refusal writes no file and no row.

## Rules that bind every #3814 child (verbatim rulings on the parent)
R1 peer round-robin. R2 Redis required for multi-replica only. R3 「同意：每张卡都只在"声明多副本并接上 Redis 驱动"时才生效」: the single-node default path is unchanged, multi-replica behaviour switches on only behind declared replicas>1 AND a connected Redis cluster driver, the split-brain guard is never weakened, and the deploy README "multi-node unsupported" line stays until the final gate.

## Done when
PR merged; no runtime package operation can leave replicas divergent; single node unchanged.
